activity_summary: At dinner the penny loaf looked smaller than winter's. It was still a thumb short of the notch, and still a penny. Verbeke said memory makes bread bigger. Alse, cutting it four ways, said cutting does not.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, and did not argue with the notch.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Cut it four ways, and said cutting does not.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Said the loaf was smaller than winter's and still a penny.

facets.activity: Ate the loaf cut four ways

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: It is still a penny, and it is still a thumb short of the notch.
